title: Instrument-set enumeration answer
description: Structured-decoding contract for the instruments whole-paper run-template (Scope B): the fitted model's instrument list. Each row is a MENU PICK against the instrument concept registry (or the quote-mandatory 'unrecognised' escape) plus the paper's own words -- the InstrumentRef inputs.

concept_id.description: Registry id of the matched instrument concept (or 'unrecognised').

label.description: The paper's own name for the instrument.

source_class.description: Which data domain the instrument comes from.

transform.description: Any stated transform applied to the raw characteristic (else null).
